display_long_description:
Arrow Puzzle Escape – Brain Challenge is an immersive VR puzzle game where every arrow needs a clear path to escape. Tap arrows in the right order, clear the grid, and solve brain puzzle levels using logic, focus, and strategy. Each puzzle looks simple at first, but every move matters as blocked paths, arrow directions, and grid layouts become more challenging.

Free every arrow from the board. Each arrow points in a fixed direction and can only escape when nothing blocks its path. Choose the wrong arrow too early and the puzzle can become harder, so think ahead, plan moves, and find the best escape order. This clear-the-board gameplay is easy to understand, relaxing to play, and satisfying to master.

[media]

With 600+ handcrafted levels, the game offers relaxing gameplay and brain-challenging logic puzzles. Early levels teach the arrow escape mechanics, while later levels bring complex layouts that test problem-solving, planning, and patience.

When a puzzle gets tricky, use power-ups. Hint guides you toward a possible move, while Grid Show helps you understand arrow directions and plan your escape path. These tools support strategy without removing the challenge.

[media]

Designed for comfortable VR play, the game offers a seated puzzle experience with smooth arrow movement, clean visuals, satisfying escape animations, and progressive difficulty. Great for fans of VR puzzle games, arrow puzzles, tap puzzles, brain games, logic games, escape puzzles, grid puzzles, and clear-the-board challenges.
